title: RABR normalised EMG vs external moment direction (0-180 deg) and magnitude (10-50 Nm), upright
subcategory: upright posture, asymmetric external moments via harness (co-contraction)

quantity.name: normalised EMG (baseline-subtracted)
quantity.definition: RMS EMG (300 ms analogue RMS, 20-600 Hz) averaged over 10 s, NEMG = (test - baseline)/(max - baseline) x 100, baseline = relaxed upright stance in apparatus, max = greatest value in 4 upright isometric MVCs (flexion, extension, twist L, twist R); mean across subjects

source.authors: Lavender SA, Tsuang YH, Andersson GBJ, Hafezi A, Shin CC
source.sample: 10 male subjects; healthy men, no back pain history (file E04.pdf)

protocol.summary: Upright standing, pelvis strapped to a board; external moments of 10, 20, 30, 40, 50 Nm about L3/L4 applied via a chest-level harness (front: nipple line; rear: lower tip of scapula; side over right upper arm) by horizontal cables/pulleys with weights; directions 0 (anterior pull) to 180 deg (posterior pull) in 30 deg steps toward the subject's RIGHT; load adjusted to each subject's harness-to-L3/L4 vertical lever arm; 35 trials, 10-s holds, 90-s rest.
how_to_simulate: Apply a horizontal force at chest/scapula-tip height, magnitude = M / (vertical distance harness to L3-L4 disc), producing external moment M = 10-50 Nm about L3/L4

Direction 0 deg = force pulling anteriorly (external flexion moment), 90 deg = pulling to the subject's right (right lateral bending moment), 180 deg = pulling posteriorly (extension moment); intermediate angles = vector sums

Compare predicted activation of the RABR fascicles under the electrode (right rectus abdominis, umbilicus level, 2 cm lateral to midline) with NEMG; where only a range is given, model should fall within it

subject_model.source: Lavender 1992 Methods (also trunk breadth 29.9 cm, depth 21.3 cm)

protocol.notes: Methods state 10 subjects but Results text says 'mean values across the 19 subjects' (and Eq 1 indexes j = 1..19) - inconsistency in paper; n=10 used (Methods). NEMG is baseline-subtracted so can be slightly negative/zero. SDs not reported. Directions only to the right side; authors claim symmetry from pilot data.

extraction.uncertainty: ±0.5 %MVC for separable markers (scanned line plot, 300 dpi, axis 0-30 calibrated on frame lines, 15.7 px/%); overlapping near-baseline curves given as min-max ranges
extraction.check_notes: Marker positions from pixel column scans at each direction (plus columns just outside the frame at 0/180 deg to avoid axis lines; x-marker arms averaged). Independent re-measurement on a separate crop (Fig 3B, 150 and 180 deg) by pixel profile reproduced values within 0.2 (e.g. EXOL 150 deg: 24.2/17.8/11.1/6.8/3.9; 180 deg 20 Nm 6.0 vs 5.9). Magnitude identity assigned by marker symbol and monotonic ordering; values where curves overlap near baseline reported only as min-max ranges.

pass_rule.rule: |model-mean| <= 2 %MVC (no SD reported) or within the given min-max range; direction of recruitment change with moment direction reproduced
